set protocols oam ethernet cfm domain md.template: set protocols oam ethernet cfm domain [parameter1] service [parameter2] association-id [parameter3]

set protocols oam ethernet cfm domain md.template: set protocols oam ethernet cfm domain [parameter1] service [parameter2] mep [parameter3] interface [parameter4] direction [parameter5]

set protocols oam ethernet cfm domain md.explanation: 配置以太网CFM服务的MEP接口和方向。

set protocols oam ethernet cfm domain md.template: set protocols oam ethernet cfm domain [parameter1] service [parameter2] mep [parameter3] continuity-check ccm-interval [parameter4]
set protocols oam ethernet cfm domain md.command: set protocols oam ethernet cfm domain md service ma1 mep 1 continuity-check ccm-interval 1s
set protocols oam ethernet cfm domain md.explanation: 配置以太网CFM服务的MEP连续性检查的CCM间隔。

set protocols oam ethernet cfm domain md.template: set protocols oam ethernet cfm domain [parameter1] service [parameter2] mep [parameter3] remote-mep-id [parameter4]
set protocols oam ethernet cfm domain md.command: set protocols oam ethernet cfm domain md service ma1 mep 1 remote-mep-id 2
set protocols oam ethernet cfm domain md.explanation: 配置以太网CFM服务的MEP的远程MEP ID。

set protocols oam ethernet cfm domain md.template: set protocols oam ethernet cfm domain [parameter1] service [parameter2] mep [parameter3] loss-measurement peer-mep-id [parameter4] test-id [parameter5] dual-ended continual
set protocols oam ethernet cfm domain md.command: set protocols oam ethernet cfm domain md service ma1 mep 1 loss-measurement peer-mep-id 2 test-id 1 dual-ended continual
set protocols oam ethernet cfm domain md.explanation: 配置以太网CFM服务的MEP的丢失测量。

set protocols oam ethernet cfm domain md.template: set protocols oam ethernet cfm domain [parameter1] service [parameter2] level [parameter3]

set protocols oam ethernet cfm domain md.template: set protocols oam ethernet cfm domain [parameter1] service [parameter2] association-id [parameter3]

set protocols oam ethernet cfm domain md.explanation: 配置以太网CFM服务的关联ID。

set protocols oam ethernet cfm domain md.template: set protocols oam ethernet cfm domain [parameter1] service [parameter2] mep [parameter3] interface [parameter4] direction [parameter5]
set protocols oam ethernet cfm domain md.command: set protocols oam ethernet cfm domain md service ma2 mep 4 interface ge-1/0/1.1 direction outward
set protocols oam ethernet cfm domain md.explanation: 配置以太网CFM服务的MEP接口和方向。

set protocols oam ethernet cfm domain md.template: set protocols oam ethernet cfm domain [parameter1] service [parameter2] mep [parameter3] continuity-check ccm-interval [parameter4]
set protocols oam ethernet cfm domain md.command: set protocols oam ethernet cfm domain md service ma2 mep 4 continuity-check ccm-interval 1s
